entities.summary: The Republic of Kirjasalo, commonly referred to as the Republic of North Ingria was a short-lived unrecognized state from 9 July 1919 to 5/6 December 1920. The country was located in the southern part of the Karelian Isthmus, specifically in Kirjasalo and Lempaala.
